decisions.business: the sales duration (in time periods) allocated to each possible product combination (offer set). example: [{"offer_set": [1, 2, 5], "time_allocated": 45.5}, {"offer_set": [3, 4], "time_allocated": 120.0}, {"offer_set": [], "time_allocated": 34.5}]. List every offer set allocated a non-zero duration; for completeness, unselected offer sets default to a duration of 0, and column-generation results usually show only positive entries, but all activated columns must be included.
